mapper.select: select d.id, d.user_id, d.name, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted, sum(case when c.id is not null and mastered_cards.card_id is null then 1 else 0 end) as active_count, sum(case when mastered_cards.card_id is not null then 1 else 0 end) as mastered_count from pw_deck d left join pw_card c on c.deck_id = d.id and c.deleted = 0 left join ( select card_id from pw_card_progress where user_id = #{userId} and mastered_at is not null group by card_id ) mastered_cards on mastered_cards.card_id = c.id where d.user_id = #{userId} and d.deleted = 0 group by d.id, d.user_id, d.name, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted order by d.created_at desc, d.id desc
SELECT id FROM pw_deck WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
select id, user_id, name, created_at, updated_at, deleted from pw_deck where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 limit 1
